title: Every Cashier Has a Tiny Desk
description:
> **Who is asking**
>
> **Finance** (Vesper). They own a nightly store rollup on a **wide** orders extract. Numbers have been right. The job is late. On-call suggested more executors.

The planted job aggregates a wide fact. Executors are intentionally small. **AQE is off.** Open the slow stage: task durations are **similar**. Shuffle spill (and often GC) dominate. There is no single hot `store_id` owning the stage.

This is not the skew lab. More executors copy the same tight desk onto more machines.

## Your task

1. Run or open the planted job. Read stage metrics.
2. In Investigation: state that tasks are even (not skew), and record spill (and GC if visible).
3. Fix **memory shape only** within platform caps (executor memory ≤ 1g; fractions allowed). Same executor count.
4. Re-run. Spill drops; wall clock drops; rollup still matches golden.

## Rules

- Config-only fix. Do not salt. Do not enable AQE. Do not add executors/cores. Do not sample or limit input.
- Do not raise memory above the published cap.

> **Done when**
>
> Correct rollup, memory within cap, same parallelism, spill and time budgets met, Investigation distinguishes spill from skew.

**Runners and datasets ship later.** You can open the workspace and read the brief; Run/Submit are not graded yet.

hints: AQE stays off for this chapter.
Fill Investigation before you call the job done.
Live Start ships when the lab is finalized.
